actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target is poisoned for 1 hour. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more  it falls unconscious until it is no longer poisoned  it takes damage  or a creature takes an action to shake it awake.
